title: Stablecoin Issuer Disclosure Prep
source_citation: Reserve composition and redemption disclosure preparation pattern aligned with the GENIUS Act (US, 2025) permitted-issuer disclosure requirements.

steps.title: Confirm the reserve attestation is current
steps.instruction: Confirm the independent reserve attestation covers the disclosure period and reconciles to outstanding token supply.

steps.title: Confirm the redemption policy is published and unchanged
steps.instruction: Confirm the public redemption policy matches the version reviewed by compliance, or log the change.

steps.title: Prepare the reserve composition table
steps.instruction: List reserve asset categories and percentages as required for the periodic disclosure.

steps.title: Legal sign-off on the disclosure draft
steps.instruction: Route the draft disclosure to legal for review before publication.

steps.title: Publish the disclosure
steps.instruction: Publish the disclosure to the designated channel and record the publication timestamp.
